title: Swoosh Craft
description: A movement enhancement plugin featuring momentum mechanics, directional dashes, and grappling mobility.
body:
VelocityCraft is a movement enhancement plugin focused on fast-paced traversal and fluid gameplay mechanics.

Features include:
• Momentum-based movement
• Directional dash abilities
• Grappling hook mobility
• Smooth acceleration systems
• Configurable movement settings
• Lightweight and optimized performance

Designed for SMPs, parkour servers, _PvP gameplay,_ and custom movement experiences.

# ⭐How To Use

**➡️Dash**

  🔻Hold a feather and right-click to dash forward.
  
  🔻Each successful dash consumes one feather.

**➡️Momentum**

  🔻Sprint on solid ground to gradually gain extra forward speed.
 
  🔻Momentum stops building when you stop sprinting, sneak, leave the ground, or hit the cap.        

**➡️ Grappling Hook**

  🔻Craft a Grappling Hook, cast it at a block surface(left click), then reel in to pull yourself toward it.(right click)

  🔻Sneak to detach the grapple.

  🔻Normal fishing rods still work as normal fishing rods.

➡️ Grappling Hook Recipe

 
    First row  -  Empty  | Iron Ingot  | String 
    Second row -  Empty  | Fishing Rod | Slime Ball
    Third row  -  String | Empty       | Empty 

                      OR
                      
    In chat - /swooshcraft grapple

**Upcoming Features**

- Movement-focused potions with custom effects
- Dash-enhancing potion effects
- Grapple range or pull-strength boosts
- Momentum boost potions
- Temporary air-control effects
- Fall damage resistance after movement abilities
- Cooldown reduction effects
- Craftable movement consumables
- More traversal items and upgrades

Thank You.
